digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate documentation and packaged guide
propositions: Author-facing packaged guide must document that risky runtime mechanisms whose correctness resolves only after a slow codified delivery loop (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning) must be named and proven via a concrete fast out-of-loop proof before codification.
Fast proof forms must be explicitly limited to local run or manual probe against real target, and throwaway experiments must be cleaned up by teardown scoped only to resources they created.
The new guidance must be identified as T15 and stack-agnostic without product-specific instructions (Terraform, Docker, etc.).
Hand-authored docs and registry module docstring must state the validated criterion vocabulary as 44 total criteria across T1–T15 range.
Packaged guide must be regenerated into criterion-pins.json and validated through explain_guide CLI and test suite integration.
